_readme: Labelled cases for `npm run eval`. Add a case whenever the bot gets something wrong in real use (the message, what it should have done, and why) — that turns every real mistake into a permanent check. intent: expected category (a list when the taxonomy allows either); optional replyTo: the text of the message it replies to. answers: question → the reply type expected, phrases it must contain (any of each list) and phrases it must never contain.
